changelog: [When to Segment]: added five new permissive cues targeting the critic's measured under-segmentation cases — terminal punctuation followed by a trailing NP/list, fronted temporal/locational adverbials before subordinate or main clauses, plain (non-past) completed conditionals '-으면/-으면은', leading disfluency/filler chains before the first substantive clause, and long temporal setups ending in a discourse marker like '이제' before the final main clause — to recover the large missed latency gains the critic identified without adding new restrictions.

[Never Segment]: narrowed the trailing-bare-NP prohibition so it only blocks a split when the missing predicate must be inferred from the clause being cut; if the preceding piece already ends in terminal punctuation or a closed clause, splitting before a trailing NP/list elaboration is explicitly allowed, resolving the conflict that was suppressing valid question/list boundaries.
